newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EUROPEAN FEEDS SEE LIGHT TRADE ON DOLLAR DIP.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEAN FEEDS SEE LIGHT TRADE ON DOLLAR DIP.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some nearby trade this afternoon on a dip in the dollar and calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening, market sources said.
Chicago soymeal futures opened higher on forecasts for drier weather in the U.S. Midwest than earlier predicted and short covering.
"Buyers in Europe went for nearby material as we are in a weather market and if you purchase or sell more distant material you are bound to do it wrong," one dealer said.
Arrived Brazilian soymeal pellets changed hands at $277 a tonne cif Rotterdam, $1 down from yesterday.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $264.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
EU rapemeal changed hands at 21.50 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine for week 32 delivery. Aug traded at 22.50, Sept at 23 and Oct at 24 marks fob Hamburg.
No trades were reported in other products.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
